assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia.
Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances.
CPT 93229 is the code for the prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry service.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial is based on the absence of required precertification or prior authorization.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
